message.content:
一顆普通大小的番茄（約 123 g）大約含有 **22–25 卡路里**。  
如果你想更精確地估算：

| 番茄大小 | 重量 (g) | 卡路里 (kcal) |
|----------|----------|---------------|
| 小番茄   | 80       | 約 18         |
| 中等番茄 | 123      | 約 22–25      |
| 大番茄   | 180      | 約 32–35      |

這些數值基於番茄的平均營養成分（約 0.18 kcal/g）。實際卡路里會因品種、成熟度和種植條件略有差異，但一般在上述範圍內。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "一個番茄有多少卡路里？" which means "How many calories does one tomato have?" They want the calorie content of a tomato. We can answer: about 22 calories per 100g, but a typical medium tomato (~123g) has about 22-25 calories. But the question: "一個番茄有多少卡路里？" They might want approximate value. We can give approximate: 22 calories per 100g, so a medium tomato (~123g) ~27 calories. Or a small tomato (~80g) ~18 calories. Provide typical values. Also mention that it depends on size. Provide a range. No function call needed.
